selection.memory: Greedily add maximum newly visible target vertices; ties use larger short-side fraction, higher depth-visible ratio, then earlier frame.

next_action.evaluable: Freeze up to three target views per side, then run the unchanged objects-proposal, target-only mask-foreground FFA memory and native SAM2 chain once.

forbidden_after_freeze: change family, target, view rules or memory budget
reinterpret source scarcity as algorithm failure
claim_boundary: This source gate can establish only whether the new family supplies bounded target memory. It is not algorithm evidence, referent binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
